summary: Home Manager prestage checks inspect Darwin launchd commands instead of Linux-only systemd services

replay.detail: Check-only correction; no claims, projections or caches change.

rules.detail: Production modules and paths are unchanged. Common phase/config assertions and Linux command checks remain intact.

compatibility.detail: Pure evaluation checks the emitted stage plist's single wrapper argument and the completed launchd argument. Building the Darwin check additionally requires an unconditional migration-ready guard before exec in both selected generated wrappers, checks intended executable and PTY-root paths, and rejects removed/late-guard and wrong-path mutations. Consumer fixtures use a tiny nonexecuted package and no optional PTY package to avoid product/web/PTY build closures; the real module still generates the inspected wrappers. Evaluation alone does not prove wrapper contents, and this check does not prove product execution or web assets.

downtime.detail: No activation or service-manager operations are added.

manual.detail: No operator action is required. Darwin wrapper-content proof requires building the Darwin prestage check.

recovery.detail: Reverting only restores the inherited Darwin check failure; runtime behavior is unchanged.
